extDescription.message: Dual subtitles for YouTube: every line in the original and in your language. Free, unlimited, no sign-in. Translated on your device.

buttonOn.message: Twinsub dual subtitles: on (click to turn off)

buttonOff.message: Twinsub dual subtitles: off (click to turn on)

noApi.message: Twinsub translates on your computer, which needs Chrome 138 or newer on a desktop or laptop.

unsupported.message: On-device translation from $1 to $2 isn't available in Chrome yet. Showing the original subtitles.

needsDownload.message: Click to download the $1 → $2 translation pack (one time, a few seconds)

noCaptions.message: This video has no subtitles, so Twinsub has nothing to translate.

popupHow.message: Open any YouTube video with subtitles. Twinsub turns them on and adds the translation; the button with two lines in the player bar switches it off.

popupPrivacy.message: Translation runs on your computer with Chrome's built-in translator. No account, no server, nothing about what you watch leaves your browser.
